subject: science
cluster: What plants need and animal helpers
skillName: Animals That Spread Seeds and Pollen

items.prompt:
To disperse seeds means to
A) spread them to new places
B) eat them all
C) keep them in one spot
D) destroy them
items.answer: A) spread them to new places

steps: Dispersing seeds means spreading them out.

items.prompt:
A bee carrying pollen between flowers is
A) pollinating
B) sleeping
C) eating the flowers
D) making honey only

steps: Carrying pollen between flowers is pollinating.

items.prompt:
A bird that eats fruit and drops the seeds far away is
A) dispersing seeds
B) pollinating
C) destroying seeds
D) planting trees by hand

steps: The bird spreads the seeds to new places.

items.prompt:
Pollinating helps plants
A) make seeds
B) stop growing
C) lose leaves
D) turn into animals

A sticky seed can travel by
A) hooking onto an animal's fur
B) flying on its own wings
C) swimming
D) growing legs
items.answer: A) hooking onto an animal's fur

steps: Sticky seeds hook onto fur and are carried.

items.prompt:
To model a bee picking up pollen, you could use a
A) fuzzy ball
B) glass of water
C) rock
D) mirror

steps: A fuzzy ball mimics a bee picking up pollen.

items.prompt:
Why are seeds spread far from the parent plant helpful?
A) New plants can grow in new places
B) The seeds get lost
C) It harms the plant
D) It stops new plants
items.answer: A) New plants can grow in new places

steps: Spreading seeds lets plants grow in new areas.

items.prompt:
A fuzzy ball moving pretend pollen between paper flowers models
A) a bee pollinating flowers
B) a bird flying
C) a fish swimming
D) rain falling

steps: The fuzzy ball mimics a bee carrying pollen.
